audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven full-layer chart rows read "Skill" while the content layer and packet both name a winner.
audit.why: 54.49% over 1593 games. Packet levelChart and content win[0..6] both read [Qiyana, Qiyana, Qiyana, Qiyana, Fizz, Fizz, Fizz] — the two agree with each other and with the kit: Edge of Ixtal is 7s flat, Terrashape is 7s flat with an 1100-range dash, and Audacity is a 650-range dash onto you, so pre-6 she opens every fight. Fizz's flip is Chum the Waters at 6. The full layer said Skill on rows 0-3, 5 and 6.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-3 set to Qiyana and rows 5-6 to Fizz on the full layer, matching the content layer; ratings on rows 0-3 dropped from 5/10 to 3/10; all four early whys rewritten to describe Qiyana winning those stages.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere, and the ultimate was called by the wrong name.
audit.why: Audacity is 11/10/9/8/7s and is her only way in at 650 range — that is the number the whole lane is priced off. Edge of Ixtal and Terrashape are both a flat 7s, so neither is a punish window. Supreme Display of Talent is a flat 120s at every rank.
audit.corrected: All four numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, winCon, dosFull[0].d and phases[2].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Fizz's slam grounds both of Qiyana's dashes.
audit.why: Playful/Trickster carries the grounding flag ('shuts off enemy dashes') and Chum the Waters carries it too; Terrashape (W) and Audacity (E) both carry the dash flag. A grounded Qiyana who committed without Audacity has no exit at all. Separately, Fizz's passive moves through units, so she cannot use the wave to force a wall between you.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.mid, breakdown.carry, dosFull[1].d, tradeGood and loading.

notes:
CHART: six of seven full-layer sides read "Skill" while content win[] and the packet levelChart agreed with each other on [Qiyana, Qiyana, Qiyana, Qiyana, Fizz, Fizz, Fizz]. Every side edit moves the FULL layer onto the value win[N] already holds on disk, so no content win[N] edit is proposed (the target string is already there; a no-op would be rejected). The four early whys were rewritten in the same proposal so the row and the sentence under it now agree that Qiyana wins levels 1-5.

DECISIVE INTERACTION ADDED: Playful/Trickster's slam and Chum the Waters both carry grounding, and Terrashape and Audacity are both dashes — a grounded Qiyana who has already spent Audacity has no exit. The page never said this, which is the single strongest thing Fizz has in the matchup.

BOTH PACKET NAME FLAGS WERE REAL: the content early paragraph called her ultimate 'Elemental Wrath' (that is a Q-slot name; the ultimate is Supreme Display of Talent) and the mid paragraph invented 'Nimble Fizzy-Q' for Fizz's Urchin Strike. Both corrected.

ALSO FIXED, not flagged by lint: wants.you[0] said to 'farm from max range with Urchin Strike pokes'. Urchin Strike is a 550-range dash onto a target, not a ranged poke — following that advice walks you into her.

report[1].t, report[4].t, report[9].t and report[11].t remain misgendered (lint MISGENDER) — outside the two-report sweep cap.

UNVERIFIED, not written: whether Terrashape's terrain flag means she can actually wall off Fizz's Urchin Strike dash (the flag may be a tooltip-parsing artefact of the ice element), and whether Playful/Trickster's untargetability dodges the Supreme Display of Talent stun or only its damage.
